ground.scope: Many-sorted universally closed clauses with ground goals and explicit equality axioms. A separate checker validates every used ground instance. Wang checks the ground resolution; general formula clausification and an in-grid ground-instance checker are separate.

in-grid.scope: The fixed Wang certificate checks both ground-instance admission and resolution. Clause schemas, finite term bound and typed atom catalogue are public problem inputs. General non-clausal front-end compilation and unbounded search remain separate.

propositional.scope: Propositional clauses, automatically searched and independently verified. The circuit leaves each derived clause, pivot and reference unpinned. Compiled gates and instance dimensions are part of the problem data.
